policy: This is an index of the specifically inspected entries, not a safety approval for unlisted scripts. No runtime entry or aggregate repository command is executed by S00.

s00Verification.proof: The verifier checks its own import allowlist, forbids process and network capability tokens in its own source, and requires every write call site to name the temporary directory.

reviewedEntrypoints.coverage: every file under scripts/, every package.json including the root manifest, every vitest/vite config, every .github/workflows file, and the four runtime startup entries listed below
reviewedEntrypoints.derivation: side effects and status are recomputed from current file text, including one indirection hop; a hand-written label that understates a side effect fails the check

notRunCommandReasons.npm run verify: verify:deps then verify:scripts, typecheck, build and test; verify:scripts executes PowerShell lifecycle, canary and rollout test scripts
notRunCommandReasons.npm run verify:isolated: builds the dashboard into data-test/v390-build inside the repository and then runs every workspace test
notRunCommandReasons.npm run verify:scripts: runs v394 stage6 set-readonly and preflight with --self-test plus four PowerShell test scripts, one of which is a rollout contract
notRunCommandReasons.npm run storage:reset-testnet: drops and recreates a runtime database
notRunCommandReasons.npm run v394:stage6:readonly: opens and updates the persisted settings database

corrections: Round 1 recorded 19 entries as boundary-eligible, twelve of them with an empty side-effect list, including three start-* launchers, two acceptance runners, two source-rewriting patch scripts and the credential helper. Round 2 derives the labels from file content: eight entries remain boundary-eligible and the listed nine are forbidden.
